messages:
incidentbot: PagerDuty page fired for service=hosted-api-eu, severity=page, summary="5xx spike on /v1/generate (eu-west-1)". PD link: https://redwood.pagerduty.com/incidents/PD12345 :rotating_light:

pagerbot: auto-ack attempt failed, escalating to on-call.

luis: oncall here, I'm looking. can someone grab logs? @nora @maria

nora: pulling logs, querying kube pods: `kubectl -n hosted logs -l app=api-gateway --since=15m | grep "5xx" | head`

nora: found repeated "upstream read timeout" from haproxy -> inference-svc-1

maria: confirming infra: autoscaler not scaling, pod CPU low. could be networking. checking AZ health.

sam: ran curl against /v1/generate from eu-west-1 -> 502 consistently. gateway returns 502 before reaching model.

luis: rolling restart gateway pod to clear connections: `kubectl -n hosted rollout restart deployment/gateway --request-timeout=2m`

pagerbot: restart initiated by luis

nora: restart completed for pod gateway-57d4f. errors dropped to ~20/min but still above baseline

luis: can we fail traffic to dedicated pool as fallback? trigger route policy `rdw-route failover dedicated-eu`

maria: initiating route change, setting header X-Redwood-Fallback=dedsvc. applying...

pagerbot: route policy applied, 25% traffic shifted to dedicated pool

support-jay: customer-facing note: informing top 20 affected accounts. Draft message in #support-desk for review.

sam: latency for generate reduced but some 5xx remain originating from inference-svc-2 (pod oom-kill?)

nora: checking node events: 3 OOMKills on inference-svc-2 - memory pressure on node

maria: scaling inference-svc deployment replicas +2 and enabling eviction protection on nodes in eu-west-1

luis: good. continuing to monitor. what's current error rate?

pagerbot: current 5xx rate: 4.6/min (baseline 0.5/min). after routing change dropped from 22/min -> 4.6/min

luis: ok mitigation in place. I'll stay on this until error rate <1/min for 30m. handing detailed followup to nora for post-incident analysis. @nora take ownership for postmortem.

nora: taking postmortem ownership. collecting logs, perf graphs, and timeline.

maria: I'll liaise with infra to schedule node remediation and root cause (kernel oom vs config).

support-jay: posting customer note: "We've mitigated a partial outage affecting inference requests in eu-west-1. Failover to dedicated capacity reduced error rates. We're investigating root cause and will update in 2 hours." PTAL: link to draft https://docs.redwood.com/incident-drafts/PD12345

luis: thanks team. closing page from rotation. please add any remaining followups to the incident board.

pagerbot: PagerDuty incident PD12345 acknowledged by luis, status changed to 'under investigation'.

incidentbot: thread closed to reduce noise — continue updates in #incidents-pd-postmortem when ready.
